item.title: Understanding Neural Networks Through Sparse Circuits
item.description: OpenAI is exploring mechanistic interpretability to understand how neural networks reason. Our new sparse model approach could make AI systems more transparent and support safer, more reliable behavior.

item.title: Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs
item.description: IH-Challenge trains models to prioritize trusted instructions, improving instruction hierarchy, safety steerability, and resistance to prompt injection attacks.

item.title: How Confessions Can Keep Language Models Honest
item.description: OpenAI researchers are testing “confessions,” a method that trains models to admit when they make mistakes or act undesirably, helping improve AI honesty, transparency, and trust in model outputs.

item.title: Why language models hallucinate
item.description: OpenAI’s new research explains why language models hallucinate. The findings show how improved evaluations can enhance AI reliability, honesty, and safety.

item.title: Reasoning Models Chain Of Thought Controllability
item.description: OpenAI introduces CoT-Control and finds reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought, reinforcing monitorability as an AI safety safeguard.

item.title: Defining and evaluating political bias in LLMs
item.description: Learn how OpenAI evaluates political bias in ChatGPT through new real-world testing methods that improve objectivity and reduce bias.

item.title: Detecting And Reducing Scheming In Ai Models
item.description: Apollo Research and OpenAI developed evaluations for hidden misalignment (“scheming”) and found behaviors consistent with scheming in controlled tests across frontier models. The team shared concrete examples and stress tests of an early method to reduce scheming.

item.title: Evaluating AI’s ability to perform scientific research tasks
item.description: OpenAI introduces FrontierScience, a benchmark testing AI reasoning in physics, chemistry, and biology to measure progress toward real scientific research.

item.title: Gdpval
item.description: OpenAI introduces GDPval, a new evaluation that measures model performance on real-world economically valuable tasks across 44 occupations.

item.title: Gpt 4 1
item.description: Introducing GPT-4.1 in the API—a new family of models with across-the-board improvements, including major gains in coding, instruction following, and long-context understanding. We’re also releasing our first nano model. Available to developers worldwide starting today.

item.title: Evaluating Chain Of Thought Monitorability
item.description: OpenAI introduces a new framework and evaluation suite for chain-of-thought monitorability, covering 13 evaluations across 24 environments. Our findings show that monitoring a model’s internal reasoning is far more effective than monitoring outputs alone, offering a promising path toward scalable control as AI systems grow more capable.

item.title: Accelerating Biological Research In The Wet Lab
item.description: OpenAI introduces a real-world evaluation framework to measure how AI can accelerate biological research in the wet lab. Using GPT-5 to optimize a molecular cloning protocol, the work explores both the promise and risks of AI-assisted experimentation.

item.title: Introducing Indqa
item.description: OpenAI introduces IndQA, a new benchmark for evaluating AI systems in Indian languages. Built with domain experts, IndQA tests cultural understanding and reasoning across 12 languages and 10 knowledge areas.

item.title: Sora 2
item.description: Our latest video generation model is more physically accurate, realistic, and controllable than prior systems. It also features synchronized dialogue and sound effects. Create with it in the new Sora app.

item.title: New Result Theoretical Physics
item.description: A new preprint shows GPT-5.2 proposing a new formula for a gluon amplitude, later formally proved and verified by OpenAI and academic collaborators.

item.title: Extending Single Minus Amplitudes To Gravitons
item.description: A new preprint extends single-minus amplitudes to gravitons, with GPT-5.2 Pro helping derive and verify nonzero graviton tree amplitudes in quantum gravity.

item.title: Gpt 5 Lowers Protein Synthesis Cost
item.description: An autonomous lab combining OpenAI’s GPT-5 with Ginkgo Bioworks’ cloud automation cut cell-free protein synthesis costs by 40% through closed-loop experimentation.

item.title: First Proof Submissions
item.description: We share our AI model’s proof attempts for the First Proof math challenge, testing research-grade reasoning on expert-level problems.

item.title: How People Are Using Chatgpt
item.description: New research from the largest study of ChatGPT use shows how the tool creates economic value through both personal and professional use. Adoption is broadening beyond early users, closing gaps and making AI a part of everyday life.

item.title: Introducing Evmbench
item.description: OpenAI and Paradigm introduce EVMbench, a benchmark evaluating AI agents’ ability to detect, patch, and exploit high-severity smart contract vulnerabilities.

item.title: Why We No Longer Evaluate Swe Bench Verified
item.description: SWE-bench Verified is increasingly contaminated and mismeasures frontier coding progress. Our analysis shows flawed tests and training leakage. We recommend SWE-bench Pro.

item.title: Introducing Aardvark
item.description: OpenAI introduces Aardvark, an AI-powered security researcher that autonomously finds, validates, and helps fix software vulnerabilities at scale. The system is in private beta—sign up to join early testing.

item.title: Advancing Independent Research Ai Alignment
item.description: OpenAI commits $7.5M to The Alignment Project to fund independent AI alignment research, strengthening global efforts to address AGI safety and security risks.

item.title: Scaling Social Science Research
item.description: GABRIEL is a new open-source toolkit from OpenAI that uses GPT to turn qualitative text and images into quantitative data, helping social scientists analyze research at scale.

item.title: Accelerating Science Gpt 5
item.description: OpenAI introduces the first research cases showing how GPT-5 accelerates scientific progress across math, physics, biology, and computer science. Explore how AI and researchers collaborate to generate proofs, uncover new insights, and reshape the pace of discovery.

item.title: The State Of Enterprise Ai 2025 Report
item.description: Key findings from OpenAI’s enterprise data show accelerating AI adoption, deeper integration, and measurable productivity gains across industries in 2025.

item.title: Evals Drive Next Chapter Of Ai
item.description: Learn how evals help businesses define, measure, and improve AI performance—reducing risk, boosting productivity, and driving strategic advantage.

item.title: Browsecomp
item.description: BrowseComp: a benchmark for browsing agents.

item.title: Affective Use Study
item.description: An OpenAI and MIT Media Lab Research collaboration.

item.title: Our Approach To The Model Spec
item.description: Learn how OpenAI’s Model Spec serves as a public framework for model behavior, balancing safety, user freedom, and accountability as AI systems advance.
